# Flamingo Revolution Diaspora

> Flamingo Revolution Diaspora (Albanian: "Diaspora marshon", also "Diaspora zbarkon") is the diaspora wing of the Flamingo Revolution (Revolucioni Flamingo), the civic movement behind the daily anti-government protests in Tirana, Albania, that began on 31 May 2026. The site organizes Albanians abroad who come to Tirana to march, and tracks the protests night by night.

## Language

Every page exists in Albanian (`sq`, at the root) and English (under `/en`).

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en): The diaspora march in Tirana: the next march and how to join it.
- [Protest Pulse](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/pulsi): A day-by-day participation index for the Tirana protests since 31 May 2026, estimated by a crowd-counting model from News24 livestreams and normalized so 100 = the largest day (20 June 2026), with a short note for every night and the key moments. Figures are estimates, not head counts.
- [How Pulsi counts](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/pulsi/metodologjia): The method behind the index: source livestreams, the CLIP-EBC crowd-counting model, the visual check of split-screen frames, normalization, anchor days and limitations.
- [Pulsi data (CSV)](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/pulsi/protest_days.csv): The full published series, one row per day, with index values, source and notes in Albanian and English.
- [Pulsi RSS](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/pulsi/feed.xml): One item for each new protest day (Albanian feed at /pulsi/feed.xml).
- [Safety and your rights](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/siguria): A practical protest guide for Albania: what to do if detained or exposed to tear gas, free legal aid and emergency numbers.
- [The Scandal Dossier](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/liste_vuajtjesh): Rama-government scandals from 2013 to 2026, each checked against Albanian investigative journalism (mainly Citizens.al and Reporter.al). Claims should be evaluated against the cited sources.
- [Shared clothing](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/veshja): A preview of the diaspora T-shirts for the march in Tirana.
- [Contact](https://www.diaspora-zbarkon.com/en/contact): How to reach the organizers.

## Related

- [Flamingo Revolution](https://www.flamingorevolution.eu/): The movement's main site, with news, the Flamingo Times, the protest map and the referendum initiative.
